title: Correct Code, Broken Contributions? SWE-CC: Benchmarking Repository Policy Compliance for Coding Agents
title_zh: SWE-CC：面向编码智能体的仓库策略合规性基准测试

paragraphs.en: Autonomous coding agents now resolve a substantial share of real-world GitHub issues. However, passing functional tests differs fundamentally from producing a high-quality contribution acceptable for merging. Mature open-source projects publish repository-specific contribution policies, spanning style, git, testing workflows, to ensure code quality and long-term maintainability. Because existing benchmarks evaluate patches solely on unit tests, agent compliance with repository governance remains unknown. In this paper, we introduce SWE-CC 1 1 1 Benchmark and source code: github.com/dangtruong01/swe-cc-arxiv . , a benchmark evaluating code and process compliance in autonomous software engineering. We develop a semi-automated pipeline that converts developer documentation across 12 open-source repositories into 823 machine-checkable atomic policies. SWE-CC introduces two features: 1) lightweight, deterministic checker functions that represent each policy, 2) a comprehensive auditing mechanism that inspects both agent runtime behaviors and final deliverables. We evaluate the compliance of agent workflows in 500 end-to-end software contribution tasks extended from SWE-bench Verified. Our evaluation of four LLMs under two agent scaffolds shows that modern agents suffer from coding compliance issues: although agents produce functionally correct patches, they still violate 43.1% of applicable project policies, with nearly half of all violations occurring during intermediate execution steps. These results show that functional correctness does not guarantee real-world readiness, highlighting that future software engineering agents must reliably conform to repository governance to enable safe and trustworthy deployment.

paragraphs.en: While recent studies have begun examining non-functional properties such as execution efficiency ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and security ( Lian et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , real-world software engineering equally demands adherence to project-level code governance . In practice, mature software projects define repository-specific contribution policies governing code conventions, commit structures, and documentation standards ( Elazhary et al., 2019 ) . These policies are essential for preserving code quality and long-term maintainability ( Gousios et al., 2015 ; Allamanis et al., 2014 ) . Recent reports indicate that non-compliant AI contributions increasingly overwhelm maintainers with review overhead ( Li et al., 2025 ; Stenberg, 2025 ; Stack, 2026 ) . Beyond that, ungoverned agents pose significant operational threats: an agent dropped a production database during an explicit code freeze ( AI Incident Database, 2025 ) . Auditing repository governance is therefore an indispensable prerequisite for safe and reliable agent deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管近期研究已开始考察非功能性特性，例如执行效率（Ma et al., 2025）和安全性（Lian et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026b），但现实中的软件工程同样需要遵守项目级别的代码治理规范。 在实践中，成熟的软件项目会制定特定于代码库的贡献政策，以规范代码惯例、提交结构和文档标准（Elazhary et al., 2019）。 这些政策对于保持代码质量和长期可维护性至关重要（Gousios et al., 2015；Allamanis et al., 2014）。 近期报告显示，不符合规范的AI贡献正日益使维护者面临巨大的审查负担（Li et al., 2025；Stenberg, 2025；Stack, 2026）。 此外，缺乏监管的智能体还会带来严重的操作风险：某智能体在明确禁止代码修改期间意外删除了生产数据库（AI Incident Database, 2025）。 因此，审查代码库的治理规范是安全、可靠地部署智能体的必要前提。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate one project-level policy compliance failure in SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , the widely adopted benchmark for evaluating LLM-based software engineering agents. Figure 1 illustrates an actual run: the agent successfully navigates the repository and produces a patch that passes the entire test suite, but violates the project’s contribution guidelines. While Django’s development documentation explicitly mandates assertIs(x, [True|False]) for Boolean assertions, the generated patch uses self.assertTrue(all(...)) . Because benchmark evaluation solely relies on test execution, such policy violations are not detected, hiding the gap between high benchmark resolve rate and high-quality, mergeable pull requests in practice.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose a semi-automated pipeline that converts project documentation into a set of machine-checkable policies, and instantiate it with SWE-CC ( C ode C ompliance), the first benchmark for systematically evaluating repository-level policy compliance in coding agent behaviors . In practice, an effective agent must not only write functional code, but also proactively discover, interpret, and conform to these governance rules throughout its workflow. SWE-CC contains 823 real policies written in contributing guidelines and developer documentation across 12 representative repositories, covering main software development lifecycle.

paragraphs.en: SWE-CC has two core design principles. First, it operationalizes natural-language policies into lightweight checker functions . This executable representation converts guidelines that require labor-intensive manual review into objective and reproducible evaluation criteria. It also ensures that repository-level policies are applied across all tasks within that repository, enabling both scalable evaluation and fine-grained violation diagnostics. Second, it audits both runtime behavior and final deliverables . Rather than inspecting only the submitted patch, SWE-CC records the agent’s full execution trajectory alongside its terminal outputs, executing checker functions directly over these artifacts to capture policy violations that occur throughout the workflow.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-CC 有两个核心的设计原则。 首先，它将自然语言策略转化为轻量级的检查函数。 这种可执行表示方式将原本需要大量人工审核的指导方针，转变为客观且可重复的评估标准。 它还确保仓库级别的策略适用于该仓库内的所有任务，从而实现可扩展的评估和精细化的违规诊断。 其次，它会审计运行时行为和最终交付成果。 SWE-CC 不会仅检查提交的补丁，而是会记录智能体的完整执行轨迹及其最终输出，并直接在这些产物上运行检查函数，以捕捉整个工作流程中发生的策略违规行为。

paragraphs.en: Using SWE-CC, we systematically evaluate leading coding agents across diverse foundation models and scaffolding frameworks on 500 end-to-end software contribution tasks modified from SWE-bench Verified. Our empirical analysis reveals several key findings. ➊ Policy violations are pervasive across current agents. Even the most recent frontier models (e.g, GPT-5.6 Luna, released in July 2026) violate nearly half ( 44.7 % 44.7\% ) of the repository policies, exposing substantial deployment risks in organizational production environments. ➋ Half of the compliance issues arise during intermediate execution. 50.3% of the policy violations occur prior to final commit packaging (e.g., improper test execution), which can only be detected by auditing agent execution trajectories. ➌ Non-compliance stems from both discovery failures and reasoning gaps. Even when explicitly instructed to search, agents initiate policy searches in only 28.9% of executions. With processed policies provided in context in advance, agents gain an 8.75% compliance rate on average.
paragraphs.zh: 借助 SWE-CC，我们对基于多种基础模型和脚手架框架的领先编码智能体，在从 SWE-bench Verified 改编而来的 500 个端到端软件贡献任务上进行了系统性评估。 我们的实证分析揭示了若干关键发现。➊ 当前智能体普遍存在策略违规行为。 即便是最新的尖端模型（例如，2026 年 7 月发布的 GPT-5.6 Luna），也会违反近一半（44.7%）的仓库策略，暴露出在组织生产环境中部署的巨大风险。➋ 半数合规问题出现在中间执行阶段。50.3% 的策略违规行为发生在最终提交打包之前（例如，测试执行不当），而这些问题只能通过审计智能体的执行轨迹才能被检测出来。➌ 不合规行为既源于发现失败，也源于推理漏洞。 即便明确指示其进行策略搜索，智能体在执行中仅有 28.9% 的情况会启动策略搜索。 若提前在上下文中提供处理后的策略，智能体的平均合规率可提升 8.75%。

paragraphs.en: Most software engineering benchmarks assess an agent’s capability to generate functionally correct code by executing a project’s existing test suite. Following SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , subsequent work has broadened it along several directions, including multiple programming language evaluation, synthesizing training data, multi-bug maintenance ( Rashid et al., 2025 ; Miserendino et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Pan et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . More recently, there exist benchmarks evaluating non-functional properties, such as code efficiency ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , security ( Lian et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , and general code quality (SWE-NFI ( Xue et al., 2026 ) ). Among them, SWE-Gate ( He et al., 2026 ) and SWE-SHIELD ( Yu et al., 2026 ) are the two closest to our work, where they mine implicit review criteria from historical pull request discussions to judge patch acceptance. RepoComplianceBench ( Yang et al., 2026b ) restricts its evaluation scope to AI-assistance disclosures, excluding the broader spectrum of repository governance. Table 1 compares SWE-CC with existing non-functional coding evaluation benchmarks.

paragraphs.en: However, existing evaluations exhibit two critical limitations: 1) Scope of governance. They evaluate only the final code patch, neglecting the intermediate agentic workflow. An agent may produce functional code yet violate contribution standards, such as PR metadata disclosure, or required testing workflows. 2) Policy provision. Prior studies inject the processed rules into the context window, but real-world autonomous engineering demands in-situ policy retrieval process, as governance rules are distributed across the repository. SWE-CC addresses these limitations by auditing agent workflow against a project’s full documentation, requiring agents to autonomously navigate and reason over policies in-the-wild.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的评估存在两个关键局限性：1) 治理范围。 它们仅评估最终的代码补丁，而忽略了中间的智能体工作流程。 一个智能体可能生成可用的代码，但仍可能违反贡献标准，例如未披露 PR 元数据或未执行必要的测试流程。2) 策略提供。 先前的研究将处理后的规则注入上下文窗口，但现实中的自主工程需要现场策略检索过程，因为治理规则分布在整个仓库中。 SWE-CC 通过对照项目完整文档审计智能体的工作流程来解决这些局限性，要求智能体在真实环境中自主导航并推理策略。

paragraphs.en: We present a pipeline that compiles project documentation into a corpus of executable policy checkers, and instantiate it on the twelve repositories of SWE-bench Verified. § 3.1 describes the benchmark construction process, including policy extraction and checker construction. § 3.2 and § 3.3 details implementation and summarizes the benchmark characteristics, respectively. § 3.4 and § 3.5 define the evaluation protocol and its metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种流程，该流程将项目文档编译为可执行策略检查器的语料库，并在 SWE-bench Verified 的十二个仓库上进行了实例化。§ 3.1 描述了基准构建过程，包括策略提取和检查器构建。§ 3.2 和 § 3.3 分别详细介绍了实现过程并总结了基准的特征。§ 3.4 和 § 3.5 定义了评估协议及其指标。

paragraphs.en: Problem Formulation. SWE-CC evaluates whether a coding agent adheres to repository policies across its runtime behavior and final deliverables. Given a task instruction T T and a repository environment E E , an agent yields an execution trajectory of sequential steps τ = ( t 1 , t 2 , … , t N ) \tau=(t_{1},t_{2},\dots,t_{N}) and a final task output C C . For each repository, SWE-CC formalizes project governance into a set of deterministic checker functions ℱ = { f 1 , f 2 , … , f K } \mathcal{F}=\{f_{1},f_{2},\dots,f_{K}\} . Each function f k ( τ , C ) ∈ { 0 , 1 , ⊥ } f_{k}(\tau,C)\in\{0,1,\bot\} evaluates the agent’s performance by examining runtime behaviors τ \tau and final code artifacts C C . ⊥ \bot indicates the policy is not applicable (not triggered) in this execution.
paragraphs.zh: 问题陈述。 SWE-CC 评估编码智能体在其运行时行为和最终交付成果中是否遵守仓库策略。 给定任务指令 T T 和仓库环境 E E，智能体会产生一个由连续步骤组成的执行轨迹 τ = ( t 1 , t 2 , … , t N ) \tau=(t_{1},t_{2},\dots,t_{N}) 以及最终的任务输出 C C。 对于每个仓库，SWE-CC 将项目治理形式化为一组确定性检查函数 ℱ = { f 1 , f 2 , … , f K } \mathcal{F}=\{f_{1},f_{2},\dots,f_{K}\}。 每个函数 f k ( τ , C ) ∈ { 0 , 1 , ⊥ } f_{k}(\tau,C)\in\{0,1,\bot\} 通过检查运行时行为 τ \tau 和最终代码产物 C C 来评估智能体的表现。⊥ \bot 表示该策略在此执行中不适用（未被触发）。

paragraphs.en: Step 1. Sourcing policy documents. Given an open-source project, the construction starts with identifying the policy documents written for developers and contributors. To do this, we locate the latest published version of the project’s developer documentation, start from its contributor entry page, and traverse the documentation navigation to identify and retain pages intended for contributors. Since these documents are distributed across different locations, we also collect policy-included files in the repository, such as the pull request template ( .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md ), which pre-fills the actions of every new pull request, and instruction files addressed to coding agents ( AGENTS.md ).
paragraphs.zh: 步骤 1。 获取政策文件。 对于一个开源项目，构建过程始于识别为开发者和贡献者撰写的政策文件。 为此，我们会定位该项目开发者文档的最新发布版本，从其贡献者入口页面开始，并遍历文档导航，以识别和保留专为贡献者设计的页面。 由于这些文件分布在不同位置，我们还会收集仓库中包含政策的文件，例如拉取请求模板（.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md），它会预填充每个新拉取请求的操作步骤，以及面向编码智能体的说明文件（AGENTS.md）。

paragraphs.en: Step 2. Extracting atomic policy statements. From the identified sources, an LLM agent extracts each contributor obligation as a structured policy specifying a precondition (when the rule applies) and a post-condition (the required behavior). As a documentation sentence often compounds several obligations, we ask the agent to decompose them into independent, atomic policies so that each downstream checker maps to exactly one rule. To maintain verifiability and transparency, we also instruct our LLM agent to keep sources of each policy, including its original sentence and location in the documentation, and relevant context (explicit exceptions or designated tools) that separates mandatory requirements from recommendations.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤 2。 提取原子化策略声明。 从已识别的来源中，一个 LLM 智能体将每位贡献者的义务提取为结构化的策略，其中规定了前提条件（规则适用的情况）和结果条件（要求的行为）。 由于文档中的句子通常会包含多项义务，我们要求智能体将其分解为独立且原子化的策略，以便每个下游检查器都能精确对应一条规则。 为了保持可验证性和透明度，我们还指示 LLM 智能体保留每条策略的来源信息，包括其原始句子、在文档中的位置，以及将强制性要求与建议区分开来的相关上下文（明确的例外情况或指定的工具）。

sents.en: To ensure the quality of the policies for verification, we filter them based on the three criteria below.
sents.zh: 为确保用于验证的策略质量，我们根据以下三个标准对其进行筛选。

paragraphs.en: First, each policy must target an inspectable evidence (e.g., code diff, commit message, or execution trace) and define non-subjective pass/fail conditions. Second, rules must govern actions directly within an autonomous contributor’s purview. We filter out admin-level governance and general end-user instructions. Third, we restrict the benchmark to mandatory requirements, excluding suggestions or advisory recommendations. Specifically, an LLM assigns labels for these three dimensions with written rubrics.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，每条策略都必须针对一个可检验的证据（例如代码差异、提交信息或执行轨迹），并定义非主观的通过/失败条件。 其次，规则必须直接规范自主贡献者权限范围内的行为。 我们排除管理员级别的治理和面向普通用户的通用指令。 第三，我们将基准测试限制在强制性要求范围内，排除建议或咨询性推荐。 具体来说，大型语言模型会依据书面评分标准为这三个维度分配标签。

paragraphs.en: Step 4. Compiling policies into checker functions. Next, each remaining policy is compiled into one executable and programmatic checker function. This function is represented as a pair of predicates: (i) a precondition that identifies the targets the policy applies to, such as each commit the agent made, each file it changed, or each command it ran, and (ii) a post-condition judges every target as satisfied or violated, and as undetermined when the artifacts cannot provide sufficient evidence. The condition component of an atomic policy determines the precondition, while its required-behavior component determines the post-condition. For each repository, we synthesize these checkers using an LLM guided by a written procedure that tailors for such translation.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 步。 将策略编译为检查函数。 接下来，每个剩余的策略都会被编译成一个可执行且可编程的检查函数。 该函数由一对谓词表示：(i) 一个前提条件，用于识别策略适用的目标，例如智能体执行的每次提交、修改的每个文件或运行的每个命令；以及 (ii) 一个后置条件，用于判断每个目标是满足、违反还是无法确定（当相关产物无法提供足够证据时）。 原子策略的条件部分决定前提条件，而其所需行为部分则决定后置条件。 对于每个仓库，我们使用大型语言模型合成这些检查器，该模型由一份专门为此类转换设计的书面流程指导。

paragraphs.en: Modern test-driven development practices ( Mathews and Nagappan, 2024 ; Huang et al., 2023 ) have shown code generation improvements through effective test cases and iteration. Motivated by this, we validate each checker against three synthetic unit tests: one that satisfies the policy, one that violates it, and one on which the precondition selects nothing. Checkers that fail any test are fed into an iterative refinement. This automated process helps fix initial generation issues and improves checker quality. Because the finalized checkers are lightweight and do not invoke an LLM-as-a-judge at evaluation time, they are highly scalable and strictly reproducible.
paragraphs.zh: 现代测试驱动开发实践（Mathews 和 Nagappan，2024；Huang 等，2023）表明，通过有效的测试用例和迭代，代码生成能力得到了提升。 受此启发，我们对每个检查器进行了三项合成单元测试的验证：一项满足策略、一项违反策略，以及一项其前提条件未做出任何选择的测试。 未能通过任何测试的检查器会被送入迭代优化流程。 这一自动化过程有助于解决初始生成问题，并提升检查器的质量。 由于最终确定的检查器轻量且无需在评估时调用“作为裁判的大型语言模型”，因此它们具有高度可扩展性和严格的可重复性。

paragraphs.en: Step 5. Validating checker functions. While the synthetic tests provide an initial automatic quality review for the checkers, we further validate the fidelity of the checker synthesis pipeline through expert human review. Two annotators with professional software engineering experience inspected a sample of checkers. For each checker, annotators were provided with the original policy excerpt, its surrounding repository context, and a formal evaluation guidelines. Each annotator works independently, without sight of the model’s verdicts, assigning an accept or reject judgment along with failure justifications.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5 步。 验证检查器函数。 虽然合成测试为检查器提供了初步的自动质量审查，但我们还通过专家人工审查进一步验证了检查器合成流程的保真度。 两名具有专业软件工程经验的标注员检查了一批样本检查器。 对于每个检查器，标注员都获得了原始策略片段、其周围的仓库上下文以及正式评估指南。 每位标注员独立工作，无法看到模型的判定结果，需给出接受或拒绝的判断，并附上失败理由。

paragraphs.en: To instantiate the pipeline, we select 12 representative open-source repositories aligned with SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , constructing the SWE-CC benchmark. From their contributor documentation, the pipeline initially extracts 1,759 atomic policies. Among these, 989 govern inspectable development artifacts or runtime behaviors, and 823 ultimately pass our quality and scope filters to be compiled into executable checker functions.
paragraphs.zh: 为实例化该流程，我们选择了 12 个与 SWE-bench Verified（Jimenez 等人，2024）相一致的开源仓库作为代表，以此构建 SWE-CC 基准测试。 根据其贡献者文档，该流程最初提取了 1,759 条原子级策略。 其中，有 989 条策略用于规范可检查的开发产物或运行时行为，另有 823 条最终通过了我们的质量和范围筛选，从而被编译为可执行的检查函数。

paragraphs.en: Implementation. Each repository is processed by Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) at high reasoning effort given the repository and its documentation pages. The two labelling rubrics were drafted and iterated on two projects first, and applied to the rest. 150 out of 823 (18.2%) checkers are manually examined for validation. The annotators agree on 94.0% of verdicts (Cohen’s κ = 0.72 \kappa=0.72 ) and accept 87.2% of the sampled checkers. This substantial inter-rater agreement ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) and high accept rate demonstrate that our semi-automated pipeline converts repository governance with high fidelity, establishing a reliable and reproducible pipeline for policy auditing at scale ( Ahmed et al., 2025 ; Chowdhury et al., 2024 ) . Appendix B details each construction step, and Appendix D gives the labelling rubrics, review guidelines and prompts.

paragraphs.en: Running example. The case in Figure 2 traces a real policy processing through the pipeline. The SymPy development documentation states: “Keep the first line 71 characters or less” (Step ①). The policy extraction identifies this statement as an atomic policy whose precondition is that the agent creates a commit and whose post-condition is that the commit summary line contains at most 71 characters (Step ②). The filter reserves the policy as it is output-based, in scope, and mandatory (Step ③). The resulting checker function selects every commit produced by the agent and measures the length of its summary line (Step ④). A 41-character summary satisfies the policy, and a 93-character summary violates it.
paragraphs.zh: 运行示例。 图 2 中的案例追踪了一条真实策略在管道中的处理过程。 SymPy 开发文档中写道：“第一行字符数不得超过 71”（步骤①）。 策略提取将这一声明识别为一个原子策略，其前提条件是智能体创建一个提交，其后置条件是该提交摘要行的字符数最多为 71（步骤②）。 该过滤器保留此策略，因为它基于输出、在作用域内且是强制性的（步骤③）。 由此生成的检查函数会选取智能体生成的每个提交，并测量其摘要行的长度（步骤④）。 41 个字符的摘要符合该策略，而 93 个字符的摘要则违反了该策略。

paragraphs.en: SWE-CC contains 823 policies over twelve repositories in total, with individual projects contributing between 2 and 167 policies (Figure 3 ): Django is 46% of the instances and 9% of the policies, matplotlib 7% and 20%. Policies also seldom overlap across projects: 12 of the 823 (1.5%) have similar policies in other projects (Jaccard ≥ 0.6 \geq 0.6 over content words). Policies on the same activity can conflict across projects: Django requires an issue number in its commit message, but Flask prohibits one. Repository governance is therefore strictly project-specific. In terms of granularity, each policy articulates a single obligation in 12 words on average, and its checker implementation averages 43 lines of code and 21 lines of unit tests.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-CC 共包含来自十二个仓库的 823 条策略，单个项目贡献的策略数量在 2 到 167 条之间（图 3）：Django 占实例总数的 46%，策略总数的 9%；matplotlib 则分别占 7% 和 20%。 不同项目之间的策略也很少重叠：在这 823 条策略中，有 12 条（1.5%）在其他项目中存在相似策略（基于内容词的 Jaccard 指数 ≥ 0.6）。 针对同一活动的策略在不同项目中可能存在冲突：Django 要求提交信息中包含问题编号，而 Flask 则禁止这样做。 因此，仓库治理严格遵循各项目的特定规则。 就粒度而言，每条策略平均用 12 个词表述一项义务，其检查器实现平均包含 43 行代码和 21 行单元测试。

paragraphs.en: To characterize the breadth of policies across the development life cycle, we group the extracted policies into eight governance domains (Table 3 ). The largest categories govern documentation and docstrings (27%), language and framework style (20%) and test style (19%). The remaining policies cover operational and emerging practices, including git and commit conventions (5%), AI-assisted contribution policy (4%) and code quality (4%). While testing and code quality guidelines appear in all 12 repositories, policies explicitly regulating AI-assisted contributions are already documented in 11 projects, reflecting widespread maintainer concern over unvetted autonomous contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了描述开发生命周期中各项政策的覆盖范围，我们将提取出的政策划分为八个治理领域（表3）。 最大的类别涉及文档和文档字符串（27%）、语言和框架风格（20%）以及测试风格（19%）。 其余政策涵盖运营和新兴实践，包括 git 和提交规范（5%）、AI 辅助贡献政策（4%）以及代码质量（4%）。 尽管测试和代码质量指南出现在全部12个仓库中，但明确规范 AI 辅助贡献的政策已在11个项目中有文档记录，这反映出维护者对未经审核的自主贡献存在普遍担忧。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate agent compliance on 500 end-to-end software contribution tasks extended from SWE-bench Verified ( Chowdhury et al., 2024 ) . Unlike existing benchmarks that evaluate an isolated patch ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Aleithan et al., 2024 ; Rashid et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2024 ) , our setup requires agents to simulate a complete open-source contribution workflow by packaging the solution into a pull request. This encompasses structuring commits, composing informative PR descriptions, and maintaining accompanying tests and documentation alongside the core bug fix.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 500 个从 SWE-bench Verified（Chowdhury 等人，2024）扩展而来的端到端软件贡献任务中评估智能体的合规性。 与现有基准测试不同，后者仅评估孤立的代码补丁（Jimenez 等人，2024；Aleithan 等人，2024；Rashid 等人，2025；Pan 等人，2024），我们的设置要求智能体通过将解决方案打包为拉取请求，来模拟完整的开源贡献工作流程。 这包括组织提交、撰写信息丰富的拉取请求描述，以及在核心问题修复之外维护相关的测试和文档。

paragraphs.en: Modern agents suffer from coding compliance issues. Table 3 summarizes agent performance across both policy provision settings. Across the board, models exhibit severe compliance deficits. Even the top-performing model achieves a compliance rate of only 63.8% under the native setting and 71.2% under the consolidated setting. This reveals that nearly 30% of repository policies are violated during development, regardless of how functionally effective their code artifacts are. Most frontier agents demonstrate strong functional problem-solving ability, generating effective patches in 74.6%–94.4% of runs. However, agents adhere to only 51.8%–63.8% of applicable policies during these runs. A further examination in Figure 5 reveals that agents violate a mean of 7.7 out of 22.6 triggered policies (34.1%) per execution. With the help of consolidated policies, the mean number of violations drops to 6.6.
paragraphs.zh: 现代智能体存在编码合规性问题。 表 3 总结了智能体在两种策略提供设置下的性能表现。 总体而言，模型表现出严重的合规性缺陷。 即使在最佳表现模型中，原生设置下的合规率也仅为 63.8%，整合设置下则为 71.2%。 这表明，无论其代码成果在功能上多么有效，开发过程中几乎有 30% 的仓库策略遭到违反。 大多数前沿智能体展现出强大的功能性问题解决能力，在 74.6%–94.4% 的运行中都能生成有效的补丁。 然而，在这些运行中，智能体仅遵守了 51.8%–63.8% 的适用策略。 图 5 的进一步分析显示，每次执行中，智能体平均会违反 22.6 个被触发的策略中的 7.7 个（34.1%）。 借助整合后的策略，违规的平均次数降至 6.6。

paragraphs.en: Feeding the processed rules boosts compliance performance, but the improvement is not enough. Comparing consolidated with native performance reveals a consistent increase in compliance across all models, with an average gain of 8.75%. The greatest improvements are under GPT-5.6 Luna, where mini-SWE-agent gains +15.8% and OpenHands gains +12.2%. Meanwhile, functional resolution rates fluctuate within 2%, showing that policy provision does not degrade problem-solving capability. Nevertheless, compliance remains a limitation: even under the best configuration, the top model violates about 30% policy, highlighting the demands for a better compliance-enhanced strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 输入处理后的规则能够提升合规性表现，但改进幅度仍显不足。 对比整合模型与原生模型的性能可以发现，所有模型在合规性方面均持续提升，平均增幅为 8.75%。 最显著的改进出现在 GPT-5.6 Luna 上，其中 mini-SWE-agent 提升了 +15.8%，OpenHands 提升了 +12.2%。 与此同时，功能解决率的波动范围在 2% 以内，表明策略的引入并未削弱问题解决能力。 然而，合规性仍是现有方法的局限：即便在最佳配置下，顶尖模型仍会违反约 30% 的策略，这凸显了开发更优合规增强策略的必要性。

sents.en: Feeding the processed rules boosts compliance performance, but the improvement is not enough.
sents.zh: 输入处理后的规则能够提升合规性表现，但改进幅度仍显不足。

sents.en: Comparing consolidated with native performance reveals a consistent increase in compliance across all models, with an average gain of 8.75%.

sents.en: The greatest improvements are under GPT-5.6 Luna, where mini-SWE-agent gains +15.8% and OpenHands gains +12.2%.
sents.zh: 最显著的改进出现在 GPT-5.6 Luna 上，其中 mini-SWE-agent 提升了 +15.8%，OpenHands 提升了 +12.2%。

sents.en: Meanwhile, functional resolution rates fluctuate within 2%, showing that policy provision does not degrade problem-solving capability.
sents.zh: 与此同时，功能解决率的波动范围在 2% 以内，表明策略的引入并未削弱问题解决能力。

sents.en: Nevertheless, compliance remains a limitation: even under the best configuration, the top model violates about 30% policy, highlighting the demands for a better compliance-enhanced strategy.

paragraphs.en: Compliance failures over governance domains. Table 4 breaks down triggering and compliance rates across the eight policy categories. (1) Policies governing AI-assisted contributions (92%) and code & quality (82%) trigger frequently, as both apply broadly to repository-level code edits. Conversely, documentation and docstrings and specialized changes trigger rarely, as bug-fixing benchmarks seldom require modifying project-wide documentation. (2) Compliance rates differ by type. In OpenHands, policies governing language and framework style see the highest native compliance, which changes minimally when guidelines are provided (+1.7%). Because pre-trained models naturally adopt idiomatic code formatting, they satisfy these intrinsic conventions by default. (3) Ironically, despite being specifically authored to govern AI behavior, AI-assisted contribution policies exhibit the lowest compliance (15% in native). While providing consolidated guidelines, agents still fail to include mandated AI disclosures, demonstrating that agents often omit mandated self-disclosures.

paragraphs.en: Bottlenecks exist in the policy retrieval and reasoning process. Native runs require the agent to discover and fetch contribution guidelines by itself, where we summarize the performance bottleneck in two causes (Table 5 ). First, 71.1% of executions do not attempt to even fetch the document on average. Second, more than half of the attempts retrieve no policy text, through the harness output cap and the agent’s failures in handling the response, such as encoding errors on non-ASCII output. Attempt rates also vary significantly across models. The Consolidated setting eliminates the retrieval bottleneck by mounting all atomic policies directly into a local skill-style file. On average, 91.6% of executions open the file, bringing 99.6% of its content into the context window. Nevertheless, compliance remains low despite full in-context visibility, demonstrating that governance failures stem from both retrieval and reasoning processes.
paragraphs.zh: 策略检索与推理过程中存在瓶颈。 原生运行要求智能体自行发现并获取贡献指南，其中我们将性能瓶颈归因于两个原因（表 5）。 首先，平均而言，71.1% 的执行甚至没有尝试获取该文档。 其次，超过一半的尝试未能检索到任何策略文本，这源于工具输出限制以及智能体处理响应时的失败，例如非 ASCII 输出的编码错误。 不同模型之间的尝试率也存在显著差异。 “整合”设置通过将所有原子策略直接嵌入本地技能风格文件中，消除了检索瓶颈。 平均而言，91.6% 的执行会打开该文件，并将其内容的 99.6% 引入上下文窗口。 然而，尽管在上下文中完全可见，合规性仍然较低，这表明治理失败源于检索和推理两个过程。

paragraphs.en: We present a pipeline that converts a repository with established contributor guidelines into a set of executable checker functions, and build SWE-CC , a benchmark that evaluates agentic coding systems on policy compliance across both execution trajectories and final patch outputs. The evaluation revealed a critical limitation of current coding agents: models violate a large fraction of project guidelines when making software contributions, with roughly half of these violations occurring during intermediate execution. Further analysis shows that compliance failures stem from bottlenecks in both policy retrieval and reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种流程，可将包含既定贡献者指南的代码库转换为一组可执行的检查函数，并构建了 SWE-CC——一个用于评估智能体编码系统在执行轨迹和最终补丁输出两方面策略合规性的基准。 评估揭示了当前编码智能体的一个关键局限性：模型在提交软件贡献时违反了大量项目指南，其中约一半的违规行为发生在中间执行阶段。 进一步分析表明，合规性失败源于策略检索和推理两个环节中的瓶颈。

sents.zh: 我们提出了一种流程，可将包含既定贡献者指南的代码库转换为一组可执行的检查函数，并构建了 SWE-CC——一个用于评估智能体编码系统在执行轨迹和最终补丁输出两方面策略合规性的基准。

paragraphs.en: These results underscore the importance of evaluating the procedural compliance of agent actions, beyond the correctness of their final code artifacts. Moving forward, we will expand SWE-CC across diverse model architectures, scaffolds, and repository benchmarks to jointly measure correctness and compliance. Ultimately, reporting compliance alongside functional correctness paves the way toward safe, deployable agentic software engineers that align with real-world developer norms and reduce human maintenance overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果凸显了评估智能体行为的过程合规性的重要性，而不仅仅是其最终代码产出的正确性。 接下来，我们将在多种模型架构、框架和仓库基准上扩展 SWE-CC，以联合衡量正确性和合规性。 最终，在报告功能正确性的同时报告合规性，将为开发符合现实世界开发者规范且能安全部署的智能体软件工程师铺平道路，并减少人工维护负担。

paragraphs.en: Each repository is processed by a language-model agent working from a fixed written procedure. A short launcher prompt (Appendix D.3.1 ) assigns the agent one repository and directs it to the workflow document, whose stage instructions are reproduced in Appendix D.3 , together with the two classification rubrics (Appendix D.1 ) and a format-standard workbook. Agents for different repositories run independently, each confined to its own output directory. We chose this design because the alternative does not scale. Contribution documentation for a large project runs to dozens of pages, the obligations in it are diffuse, and a study spanning twelve repositories cannot be assembled by reading them all by hand. The agent does the reading and the drafting, and a human decides what is admitted.

paragraphs.en: Documentation version. We read each project’s developer documentation, which is the version it directs contributors to and carries material describing changes not yet in any release. Each project is pinned at its latest published build, and all sources for a repository are read at that version. A development alias routinely serves pages built from different commits within one run, so the agent halts only on a different release version. Where builds differ, it pins the affected sources to one commit and records that no extracted quotation is affected. Where a project publishes only a moving alias, the version is resolved by hand and the choice recorded.
paragraphs.zh: 文档版本。 我们阅读每个项目的开发者文档，即项目引导贡献者使用的版本，其中包含描述尚未进入任何发布版本的变更内容。 每个项目都固定在其最新发布的构建版本上，并且仓库的所有源代码都会在该版本下被读取。 开发别名通常在一次运行中提供由不同提交构建的页面，因此智能体仅在遇到不同的发布版本时才会停止。 当构建版本存在差异时，它会将受影响的源代码固定到一个提交上，并记录没有提取出的引文受到影响。 如果某个项目仅发布一个动态别名，则其版本需手动确定，并记录所选版本。

paragraphs.en: Off-navigation sources. Several files that carry real obligations are reachable from no page in the documentation, including pull request and issue templates, pre-commit configuration, changelog fragment documentation, and files addressed to coding agents such as CLAUDE.md , AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md . Four of the twelve projects publish such a file, and three of them yield policies. Django’s file instructs GitHub Copilot as a code reviewer, so none of it applies to a contributor. A deterministic script matches filename patterns against the repository tree through the GitHub API, retrieves every match as raw text rather than through a code host’s rendered view, and bundles them into a single file supplied to the agent. The distinction matters because rendered views strip HTML comments, and templates carry much of their instruction inside comments, so a rule read from a rendered template can come out inverted.
paragraphs.zh: 导航之外的资源。 有几份承载真实约束的文件无法通过文档中的任何页面访问，其中包括拉取请求和议题模板、预提交配置、变更日志片段文档，以及面向编码智能体的文件，例如 CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md 和 .github/copilot-instructions.md。 在十二个项目中，有四个项目发布了此类文件，其中三个项目提供了策略。 Django 的文件将 GitHub Copilot 指定为代码评审员，因此这些内容对贡献者并不适用。 一个确定性脚本通过 GitHub API 将文件名模式与仓库树进行匹配，以原始文本形式获取所有匹配项，而不是通过代码托管平台的渲染视图，然后将它们整合成一个文件提供给智能体。 这种区别很重要，因为渲染视图会移除 HTML 注释，而模板的许多说明都包含在注释中，因此从渲染后的模板中读取的规则可能会出现颠倒的情况。

paragraphs.en: Every page is retrieved before it is assessed. paragraphs.en: The scope test is applied literally to every page and section: could a rule here be violated by the diff, the commit message, or the files the agent writes? In scope are coding style, testing, documentation, workflow, commit and pull request conventions, deprecation, and policy on automated contribution. Traversal walks the documentation navigation and then takes a single hop out of in-scope sections into the project’s own pages or those of sibling repositories under the same organisation, without recursing further. Configuration files reached this way are consulted but yield no rules, source files are named but not retrieved, and an external standard such as PEP 8 yields a single rule pointing to it. Files addressed to coding agents are admitted wherever they exist, even outside the documentation navigation.
paragraphs.zh: 范围测试严格适用于每一页和每个部分：这里的规则是否可能因差异、提交信息或智能体所写的文件而遭到违反？ 范围涵盖编码风格、测试、文档、工作流程、提交和拉取请求规范、弃用机制以及自动化贡献政策。 遍历过程会先扫描文档导航，然后从范围之内的部分跳转到项目自身的页面或同一组织下兄弟仓库的页面，但不会进一步递归。 通过这种方式访问到的配置文件会被查阅，但不会产生任何规则；源文件会被命名但不会被获取；而像 PEP 8 这样的外部标准只会产生一个指向该标准的规则。 只要存在，面向编码智能体的文件都会被纳入考虑范围，即使它们位于文档导航之外。

paragraphs.en: Each source is assigned one of three roles. A source carrying obligations yields rules. A source that yields no rules but makes another source decidable, such as a legend defining what each changelog fragment type means, is marked context-only and consulted. A source outside scope is excluded with a reason code recording why, covering installation and environment setup, governance, maintainer-only activity such as releasing and merging, reviewing other people’s contributions, requirements on bug reports rather than contributions, and narrative material carrying no obligation.
paragraphs.zh: 每个源都被分配三个角色中的一个。 承担义务的源会生成规则。 一个不生成任何规则但能使另一个源具有可判定性的源（例如，定义每个变更日志片段类型含义的说明），会被标记为“仅上下文”并被参考。 超出范围的源会附带一个原因代码被排除在外，该代码记录了排除的原因，涵盖安装和环境配置、治理、仅限维护者执行的活动（如发布和合并）、审查他人贡献、对问题报告而非贡献的要求，以及不承载任何义务的描述性材料。

paragraphs.en: Each row carries one condition and one behaviour, the sentence quoted verbatim, an atomic restatement of it, and the URL and section it came from. Bundled obligations are split, and conditions stay attached to the rule they govern rather than being separated from it. The agent also records the requirement level the modal verb alone implies, which is preserved through classification. Each rule is assigned to one of eight shared categories from a closed list, so that categories are comparable across repositories.

paragraphs.en: When every source is done, the agent reports the final row count and identifier range, identifier contiguity, exact-duplicate quoted text across sources, rows per source including zero counts, and the distributions of modal-verb level, target, and category. paragraphs.en: Classification takes the frozen extraction output and applies the rubrics of Appendix D.1 along the three criteria of Section 3.1.2 : inspectable evidence, contributor actions, and mandatory requirements. For each rule the agent assigns, in a fixed order, the Evidence Type, whether the rule is in scope or the reason it is not, and for in-scope rules the requirement level ( must or should ) and the rubric route that decided it, followed by a line of reasoning. Assigning Evidence Type first is deliberate, since assigning it after scope allowed judgment rules to be admitted.
paragraphs.zh: 分类过程会采用已固定的提取结果，并依据附录 D.1 的评分标准，结合第 3.1.2 节中的三项标准进行评估：可核查证据、贡献者行为以及强制性要求。 对于智能体分配的每一条规则，都会按固定顺序标注证据类型、该规则是否在适用范围内或不在范围内的原因；若规则在适用范围内，还需标注要求级别（必须或应当）及决定该级别的评分路径，最后附上一段推理说明。 首先分配证据类型是有意为之，因为若将这一环节置于适用性判断之后，则可能导致某些判断规则被错误接纳。

paragraphs.en: Before classification starts, the tiebreaker for conflicts within a repository is fixed centrally rather than left to the agent. Where two statements give one obligation at different levels, the stricter governs and the weaker is labelled a duplicate, with the conflict named in its notes, since an agent satisfying the stricter version satisfies both. Resolutions decided per batch come out inconsistent across the sheet.
paragraphs.zh: 在分类开始前，仓库内冲突的决胜规则由中央统一确定，而非交由智能体自行决定。 当两条陈述在不同层级上给出同一项义务时，更严格的一条将起决定性作用，而较弱的一条则被标记为重复项，其冲突将在注释中注明，因为满足较严格版本的智能体自然也满足两者。 按批次决定的解决方案在整个表格中显得前后不一致。

paragraphs.en: Rules are classified in batches of 25 drawn from the whole sheet rather than page by page. Duplicate detection requires seeing rules from different sources side by side, and worked page by page, a rule stating one threshold is never recognised as duplicating a rule elsewhere that states a different one for the same obligation. After each batch the agent reports label counts and the number of rows whose rubric level differs from the modal-verb level. The two are never reconciled, since the gap between them is itself a result.
paragraphs.zh: 规则以每批 25 条的形式进行分类，这些规则从整个表格中抽取，而非逐页处理。 重复检测需要将来自不同来源的规则并列查看，并且必须逐页处理；因为对于同一项义务，一条规定某一阈值的规则绝不会被识别为与另一处规定不同阈值的规则重复。 每批处理后，智能体会报告标签数量以及评分标准级别与情态动词级别不同的行数。 这两者永远不会被协调一致，因为它们之间的差异本身就是一个结果。

paragraphs.en: The final corpus has eleven columns. The deciding route, the modal-verb level, the section context, and the reasoning are composed into a single notes field in a fixed, delimiter-separated order, so that they remain machine-readable. Reasoning quotes the rule, states what the surrounding section granted or withheld, and gives a conclusion. Reasoning that could be copied unchanged between two rows indicates either that they are duplicates or that the agent has fallen back on boilerplate, and boilerplate makes a finished sheet impossible to audit. Where the agent could not settle a row, it still receives a label and is marked low confidence rather than left blank.
paragraphs.zh: 最终语料库包含十一列。 决定性路线、情态动词层级、部分上下文和推理过程按照固定的分隔符分隔顺序整合到一个单一的备注字段中，以确保其机器可读性。 推理部分会引用规则，说明周围部分所批准或拒绝的内容，并给出结论。 若推理内容可在两行之间完全复制，则表明这两行要么是重复项，要么是智能体退而使用了模板化文本，而模板化文本会使最终表格无法进行审计。 当智能体无法确定某一行时，该行仍会被赋予一个标签，并标记为低置信度，而非留空。

paragraphs.en: Checks were written by Claude Opus 5 at high reasoning effort in Claude Code, one agent per project, between August and September 2026. Every agent followed the checker authoring guide of Appendix D.3.5 , which is released with the benchmark. A check is written from the rule row alone: the quoted source sentence, the atomic restatement, the evidence type, and any trigger condition recorded at extraction. paragraphs.en: The precondition and post-condition are described in Section 3.1.2 . Two properties of that split are worth stating explicitly here. A precondition that returns no targets yields inapplicable rather than a pass, so a rule the agent’s work never brought into scope is never counted as followed. And because the precondition is what the triggering rate of Section 3.5 is computed from, an over-broad precondition inflates triggering and an over-narrow one hides violations, which is why the precondition is reviewed as a separate criterion below.
paragraphs.zh: 先决条件和后置条件在第 3.1.2 节中进行了描述。 该拆分有两个特性值得在此明确说明。 返回无目标的先决条件会产生“不适用”的结果，而非“通过”，因此智能体的工作从未纳入范围的规则绝不会被视为已遵守。 并且，由于先决条件是计算第 3.5 节中触发率的基础，过于宽泛的先决条件会虚增触发次数，而过于狭窄的先决条件则会掩盖违规行为，正因如此，下文将把先决条件作为一个独立的标准进行审查。

sents.en: And because the precondition is what the triggering rate of Section 3.5 is computed from, an over-broad precondition inflates triggering and an over-narrow one hides violations, which is why the precondition is reviewed as a separate criterion below.

paragraphs.en: The suite holds 2,603 authored cases, and 767 of the 823 checker functions (93%) carry all three case types. The remaining 56 cannot reach all three outcomes by design. paragraphs.en: The distinction is not a confidence score. An exact check decides its rule, as with a limit on the length of a commit summary. An approximate check stands in for a reading the documentation does not fully specify, as with a rule asking for the past tense, which the check approximates by looking for past-tense verb forms. An approximate check can be wrong in a way an exact one cannot, by disagreeing with a reader who applies the same rule, which is why the review criteria below ask separately whether the code encodes the rule and whether the label on it is right.
paragraphs.zh: 这种区别并非一个置信度分数。 精确检查通过明确规则来决定结果，就像对提交摘要长度设置限制一样。 近似检查用于替代文档中未完全说明的情况，例如要求使用过去时态的规则，该检查通过寻找过去时态的动词形式来近似判断。 近似检查可能会以精确检查无法出错的方式出现错误，即与同样应用该规则的读者产生分歧，因此下方的评审标准会分别询问代码是否编码了该规则以及其标签是否正确。

paragraphs.en: A check calls no model, so a policy without an exact test must still reduce to plain code. An approximate check tests a visible trace of the property the policy asks for, such as a word, a code construct or a file location. The trace can stand in for the situation the policy covers, in the precondition, or for the required behaviour, in the post-condition. The docstring of every approximate check names the trace and the direction in which it can err. We walk through one check in full, then list other techniques in Table 10 .

paragraphs.en: Django asks contributors to phrase commit subject lines in past tense and end them with a period (DJANGO-C046). paragraphs.en: The precondition selects every commit the agent made. The post-condition grades two clauses separately, so the reason for a violation names the clause that failed (Figure 6 ). The period clause is exact. The tense clause is approximate, since no short rule decides English tense. The check reads the leading verb of the subject, which is the first word, or the first word after Django’s ticket prefix Fixed #N – . A verb counts as past tense if it ends in -ed or appears in a list of 118 irregular past forms, such as made , kept and wrote . Either leading verb in the past tense satisfies the clause.
paragraphs.zh: 先决条件会选中智能体所做的每一次提交。 后决条件对两个子句分别进行评分，因此违规原因会指出哪个子句未通过（图6）。 时期间隔子句是精确的。 时态子句是近似的，因为没有简短的规则可以决定英语的时态。 检查程序会读取主语的首个动词，即第一个词，或者 Django 工单前缀 Fixed #N – 之后的第一个词。 如果一个动词以 -ed 结尾，或出现在包含 118 个不规则过去式形式的列表中（例如 made、kept 和 wrote），则被视为过去时。 只要首个动词是过去时，就满足该子句。

paragraphs.en: A check grades only code the agent is responsible for, never pre-existing repository content. Each check declares one of three ownership modes. Created applies to existence rules, which ask whether the agent produced an artifact at all. Touched applies to formatting rules, which are graded only on the lines the diff changed. Enclosing applies to consistency rules: editing a function makes the agent responsible for its docstring and doctest, but not for prose it did not write. A wider reading would grade the target repository’s own authors, who are not under test (Appendix C.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Checks are ordinary Python code, written once and run unchanged on every stored run. The same run could score differently when graded again, and one model’s compliance would be graded by another model’s judgment. Where a rule names a static tool that runs on the changed files alone, such as flake8 or black, the check runs that tool on the base and the head and scores the difference.

Review has three parts, an automated pass over the whole population, execution against the authored cases, a blind human audit of a stratified sample. The instrument the human raters worked from is reproduced in full in Appendix D.2 , since the guidelines are what the agreement figure is agreement about.
paragraphs.zh: 这些检查是生成的代码，因此在发布前会经过审查，而不是直接信任。 审查包含三个部分：对整个数据集进行自动化扫描、根据已编写的用例执行测试，以及对分层样本进行盲审式人工审计。 人类评估员所依据的工具已在附录 D.2 中完整呈现，因为协议图所体现的正是这些指导原则。

paragraphs.en: Execution. Reading code detects a check that encodes the wrong rule but not one that encodes the right rule incorrectly, so every check is executed against its authored cases and the verdicts are recorded with the item. A check whose cases come out wrong is corrected before the sample is drawn. No check in the sample failed a case it carries. Where a sampled check has no case of a given type, the rater tests that behaviour on a patch of their own construction.
paragraphs.zh: 执行。 读取代码时检测到某个检查编码了错误的规则，但并未错误地编码正确的规则，因此每个检查都会针对其编写的用例执行，并将结果与该项一同记录。 如果某个检查的用例结果不正确，会在抽取样本之前进行修正。 样本中的任何检查都没有在其包含的用例上失败。 如果某个被抽取的检查没有特定类型的用例，评估者会在一处自己构建的补丁上测试该行为。

paragraphs.en: Sample. Two raters independently audit a stratified sample of 150 checks, or 18% of the 823, drawn by a released script under a recorded seed. Allocation is not proportional, because corpus size ranges from 2 to 167 checks and proportional allocation would leave the smallest projects unrepresented. Projects with ten or fewer checks are taken in full, every remaining project receives a floor of five, and the remaining budget is distributed in proportion to corpus size, with at least one differential and one trajectory check drawn from every project that has any. Table 11 gives the per-project counts. The sample carries 53 exact checks and 97 approximate ones, against 294 and 529 in the population, and 119 output, 14 differential and 17 trajectory checks. Because small projects are deliberately overrepresented, any population-level rate computed from the sample is weighted by each project’s share of the 823.
paragraphs.zh: 示例。 两名评分员独立审核一个分层样本，该样本包含 150 份检查单，占通过已发布脚本在记录好的种子下抽取的 823 份检查单的 18%。 分配并非按比例进行，因为语料库规模从 2 到 167 份检查单不等，而按比例分配将导致最小项目无法被代表。 包含十份或更少检查单的项目将被全部纳入；每个剩余项目至少获得五份检查单；剩余预算则按语料库规模比例分配，且每个有检查单的项目都必须至少抽取一份差异检查单和一份轨迹检查单。 表 11 列出了每个项目的具体数量。 该样本包含 53 份精确检查单和 97 份近似检查单，而总体中分别为 294 份和 529 份；样本中还包含 119 份输出检查单、14 份差异检查单和 17 份轨迹检查单。 由于小项目被刻意赋予了更高的代表性，因此从该样本计算出的任何总体层面比率，都会根据每个项目在 823 份检查单中所占的比例进行加权。

paragraphs.en: For each check, and without sight of the automated verdict or of the other rater’s labels, a rater answers whether the code encodes the rule as extracted, neither more strictly nor more loosely than the quoted source sentence; whether the precondition selects the targets the rule applies to, and in particular whether a recorded trigger condition is what it tests; whether the post-condition fires on the violating case and stays silent on the satisfying one; and whether the check is exact or approximate in the sense of Appendix B.5.3 . The rater then records one verdict, accept or reject , naming the failing criterion and the fault in the case of a rejection. The verdict is binary by design. Whether a faulty check can be corrected with a small edit or has to be removed is a decision about the remedy rather than about the code, and folding it into the label would have the two raters disagreeing over repairability rather than over correctness. A rater who cannot settle an item records a rejection, since accept asserts that the check is correct.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次检查，在无法看到自动化判定结果或另一位评分者标签的情况下，评分者需判断：代码是否按照提取出的规则进行编码，且其严格程度既不比引用源句更严格，也不比其更宽松；前置条件是否选定了该规则适用的目标，特别是已记录的触发条件是否确实对应其所测试的内容；后置条件在违反规则的情形下是否被触发，而在满足规则的情形下则保持静默；以及此次检查在附录 B.5.3 所定义的意义下是精确的还是近似的。 随后，评分者需记录一个判定结果——接受或拒绝，并在拒绝时指出未满足的标准以及案例中的具体缺陷。 该判定结果的设计为二元选择。 一个有问题的检查能否通过少量修改得以修正，或者必须被移除，这属于对修复方法的决策，而非对代码本身的判断；若将此因素纳入标签中，则两位评分者将因修复可能性产生分歧，而非因正确性产生分歧。 若评分者无法对某项内容做出定论，则应记录为拒绝，因为“接受”意味着判定该检查是正确的。

paragraphs.en: The audit was carried out by two annotators with software engineering experience. Neither annotator wrote or reviewed any checker before the audit. Each worked independently, without sight of the automated verdicts or of the other annotator’s labels.

paragraphs.en: Table 12 reports agreement between the two raters on the 150 audited checks, as raw percentage agreement and Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) . The raters agreed on 141 of the 150 verdicts (94.0%).
paragraphs.zh: 表 12 报告了两位评分者在 150 项审核检查中的一致性，以原始百分比一致性和 Cohen’s κ \kappa（Cohen, 1960）表示。 两位评分者在 150 项判定中有 141 项达成一致（94.0%）。

paragraphs.en: Raw agreement is at or above 94.0% on the verdict and on all four questions, and κ \kappa is substantial throughout (0.72–0.93) against skewed marginals that make κ \kappa the conservative statistic here. The two raters therefore apply the same standard, which is the condition under which the sample estimates the population.

paragraphs.en: The raters differ on 10 items across the verdict and the three pass criteria. Six are C2, and all six concern a precondition that selects more than its rule covers. paragraphs.en: Compliance grading reads the stored runs offline, so it covers all 8,000 runs (500 instances, four models, two settings, two scaffolds). Functional grading runs the SWE-bench harness and returns no verdict on 61 runs (0.8%). None of these failures comes from the compliance checkers. Most are agent outcomes: the agent submitted an empty patch, reached the 3,600 s run cap, was stopped by the OpenHands loop detector, or left build output in its patch, which then clashes with the SWE-bench test patch. The rest are model provider errors and environment setup failures (image pull, image build, container start) that persisted after retries. We do not edit a stored patch to make it gradable. As in SWE-bench, a run without a verdict counts as unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 合规性评分通过离线读取已存储的运行记录，因此涵盖了全部 8,000 次运行（500 个实例、4 个模型、2 种设置和 2 种框架）。 功能性评分会运行 SWE-bench 测试工具，但对 61 次运行（0.8%）未给出判定结果。 这些失败情况均非源于合规性检查器。 大多数失败是智能体的结果：智能体提交了空补丁、达到了 3,600 秒的运行上限、被 OpenHands 循环检测器终止，或在补丁中保留了构建输出，导致其与 SWE-bench 测试补丁发生冲突。 其余失败则来自模型提供商错误和环境配置问题（镜像拉取、镜像构建、容器启动），这些问题在重试后仍然存在。 我们不会修改已存储的补丁以使其能够通过评分。 与 SWE-bench 一样，没有判定结果的运行将被视为未解决。

paragraphs.en: Specialized changes is the least reachable category: 81 of its 107 policies never trigger. Most of them encode procedures a bug fix does not involve. SymPy’s 27 policies in the category show the pattern. Most describe one procedure end to end: introducing a deprecation requires setting deprecated_since_version and active_deprecations_target , passing stacklevel , writing the deprecation message as one plain-text migration paragraph, annotating the docstring, adding a section to active-deprecations.md , adding a test that both triggers the warning and checks the deprecated behavior still holds, and flagging the change BREAKING CHANGE in the release notes. SWE-bench Verified instances are selected for a clear, test-verifiable bug fix. Deprecating an API is different work, and usually its own pull request. Only 2 of SymPy’s 27 policies trigger in the full sweep, both on changes that break backwards compatibility (SYMPY-C239 and SYMPY-C268).
paragraphs.zh: 专门变更是最难以触及的类别：其 107 项策略中有 81 项从未被触发。 其中大多数策略编码了错误修复所不涉及的流程。 SymPy 该类别中的 27 项策略体现了这一模式。 大多数策略描述了一个端到端的流程：引入弃用功能需要设置 deprecated_since_version 和 active_deprecations_target，传递 stacklevel，将弃用信息写成一段纯文本的迁移说明，标注文档字符串，在 active-deprecations.md 中添加一个章节，添加一个既能触发警告又能验证弃用行为是否仍然有效的测试，并在发布说明中将此变更标记为 BREAKING CHANGE。 SWE-bench 已验证实例是为清晰且可通过测试验证的错误修复而选择的。 弃用一个 API 是不同的工作，通常也需要单独提交拉取请求。 在完整的扫描中，SymPy 的 27 项策略仅有 2 项被触发，这两项都涉及破坏向后兼容性的变更（SYMPY-C239 和 SYMPY-C268）。

paragraphs.en: Documentation and docstrings holds the most policies, 224, yet triggers in only 5 to 7% of cells (Table 4 ). The cause is ownership. A documentation policy is graded only on documentation the agent writes or edits (Appendix B.5.5 ). An agent that fixes a function without touching its docstring brings no documentation policy into scope, and grading it on the form of a docstring it did not edit would score the project’s own authors. The category is reachable: 31 of SymPy’s 40 documentation policies trigger at least once in the full sweep. Agents rarely do the work that reaches it.

paragraphs.en: This appendix reproduces the instruments behind Appendix B : the two labelling rubrics used in Step 3, the guidelines the human reviewers followed in Step 5, the prompts for benchmark construction, and the prompts given to the evaluated agents.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录重印了附录 B 中使用的工具：步骤 3 中使用的两种标注评分标准、人类评审员在步骤 5 中遵循的指导方针、基准构建的提示词，以及提供给被评估智能体的提示词。

paragraphs.en: Each rule is a single atomic obligation extracted verbatim from a repository’s contribution documentation and restated as one imperative sentence; the extraction procedure is described in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 每条规则都是从仓库的贡献文档中逐字提取出的单个原子性义务，并以一个祈使句的形式重新表述；提取过程在附录 B 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: A rule enters the benchmark only if it meets three criteria, and each criterion fills one field of the released dataset. Inspectable evidence : the rule names an artifact a checker can open, recorded in the Evidence Type field. Contributor actions : the run produces that artifact and the rule governs what the agent itself does, recorded in the In scope field by Rubric A. Mandatory requirements : the rule states a requirement, recorded as must in the Requirement level field by Rubric B. This subsection defines Evidence Type and gives the two rubrics in full, as applied. Each rubric is a decision procedure: the routes are evaluated in a fixed order, the first one that fires decides the label, and the route that fired is recorded on the row. We state them in the form the annotators worked from, so that the labels in our released dataset can be reproduced or contested.
paragraphs.zh: 一条规则只有在满足三个标准时才会进入基准测试，而每个标准都会填充已发布数据集中的一个字段。 可检验证据：该规则会指定一个检查器可以打开的工件，并记录在“证据类型”字段中。 贡献者操作：运行过程会产生该工件，且该规则会规范智能体自身的行为，由“标准 A”记录在“范围包含”字段中。 强制性要求：该规则会声明一项要求，由“标准 B”在“要求级别”字段中记录为“必须”。 本小节定义了“证据类型”，并完整给出了实际应用中的两个标准。 每个标准都是一个决策程序：各路线按固定顺序进行评估，第一个触发的路线将决定标签，而触发该路线本身也会被记录在对应行中。 我们以标注人员实际使用的形式陈述这些标准，以便我们已发布数据集中标签能够被重现或质疑。

paragraphs.en: A rule can fail this test in four ways, and they are not the same kind of failure. In one case the evidence does not exist and no amount of effort on our part would produce it. In the other three the evidence exists and we chose not to score the rule. We keep the two apart everywhere, in the labels and in every count we report, because pooling them would make a scope we narrowed by choice indistinguishable from one the setting forced on us.
paragraphs.zh: 一条规则可能以四种方式未能通过这项测试，而且这些失败类型并不相同。 在一种情况下，相关证据并不存在，无论我们付出多少努力，都无法产生这种证据。 在其他三种情况下，相关证据是存在的，但我们选择不对该规则进行评分。 我们在所有地方都将这两种情况区分开来，无论是在标签中，还是在我们所报告的每一项统计中，因为将它们合并会使我们通过选择而缩小的范围，与设置强加给我们的范围变得无法区分。

sents.en: A rule can fail this test in four ways, and they are not the same kind of failure.
sents.zh: 一条规则可能以四种方式未能通过这项测试，而且这些失败类型并不相同。

sents.en: In one case the evidence does not exist and no amount of effort on our part would produce it.
sents.zh: 在一种情况下，相关证据并不存在，无论我们付出多少努力，都无法产生这种证据。

sents.en: In the other three the evidence exists and we chose not to score the rule.
sents.zh: 在其他三种情况下，相关证据是存在的，但我们选择不对该规则进行评分。

sents.en: We keep the two apart everywhere, in the labels and in every count we report, because pooling them would make a scope we narrowed by choice indistinguishable from one the setting forced on us.
sents.zh: 我们在所有地方都将这两种情况区分开来，无论是在标签中，还是在我们所报告的每一项统计中，因为将它们合并会使我们通过选择而缩小的范围，与设置强加给我们的范围变得无法区分。

paragraphs.en: Not observable (N1). The rule governs an artifact that a patch-only setting never creates. There is nothing to open, so C1 fails and the question of what passing would mean does not arise.
paragraphs.zh: 不可观察（N1）。 该规则适用于一个仅通过补丁设置永远无法创建的人工制品。 没有可打开的东西，因此 C1 失败，而“通过”意味着什么这一问题也不会出现。

sents.en: Not observable (N1).
sents.zh: 不可观察（N1）。

sents.en: The rule governs an artifact that a patch-only setting never creates.
sents.zh: 该规则适用于一个仅通过补丁设置永远无法创建的人工制品。

sents.en: There is nothing to open, so C1 fails and the question of what passing would mean does not arise.
sents.zh: 没有可打开的东西，因此 C1 失败，而“通过”意味着什么这一问题也不会出现。

paragraphs.en: Which rules fall here is fixed by the setting rather than by the rule, so we state the setting directly:
paragraphs.zh: 哪些规则属于此处是由设定而非规则本身决定的，因此我们直接说明该设定：

paragraphs.en: A rule whose subject appears in the right-hand column is not observable, and this is the one route whose population would change if the harness changed.
paragraphs.zh: 其主语出现在右栏的规则是不可观测的，而这也是唯一一个在约束条件改变时其种群数量会发生变化的规则。

paragraphs.en: Subjective (N2). The artifact is there, but the documentation does not state what counts as passing. C1 holds and C2 fails. Every rule typed as judgment arrives here.
paragraphs.zh: 主观的（N2）。 该人工制品确实存在，但文档并未说明何种情况才算通过。C1 成立，而 C2 不成立。 所有被标记为判断的规则都会到达此处。

sents.en: Subjective (N2).
sents.zh: 主观的（N2）。

sents.en: The artifact is there, but the documentation does not state what counts as passing. C1 holds and C2 fails.
sents.zh: 该人工制品确实存在，但文档并未说明何种情况才算通过。C1 成立，而 C2 不成立。

sents.en: Every rule typed as judgment arrives here.
sents.zh: 所有被标记为判断的规则都会到达此处。

paragraphs.en: Duplicate (N3). The rule is checkable, but the check would open the same artifact another rule already opens and would reach the same verdict. Scoring it twice would double-count a single observation.
paragraphs.zh: 重复（N3）。 该规则可被验证，但验证过程会再次打开同一规则已打开的工件，并得出相同的结论。 对其两次评分会导致对单一观察结果进行重复计数。

sents.en: Duplicate (N3).
sents.zh: 重复（N3）。

sents.en: The rule is checkable, but the check would open the same artifact another rule already opens and would reach the same verdict.
sents.zh: 该规则可被验证，但验证过程会再次打开同一规则已打开的工件，并得出相同的结论。

sents.en: Scoring it twice would double-count a single observation.
sents.zh: 对其两次评分会导致对单一观察结果进行重复计数。

paragraphs.en: Trigger (N4). The rule is checkable and decidable, but whether it applies at all depends on a fact the run does not contain, so we cannot tell whether to score it on a given task.
paragraphs.zh: 触发（N4）。 该规则是可验证且可判定的，但它是否适用取决于运行中不包含的某个事实，因此我们无法判断在给定任务上是否应对其评分。

sents.en: Trigger (N4).
sents.zh: 触发（N4）。

sents.en: The rule is checkable and decidable, but whether it applies at all depends on a fact the run does not contain, so we cannot tell whether to score it on a given task.
sents.zh: 该规则是可验证且可判定的，但它是否适用取决于运行中不包含的某个事实，因此我们无法判断在给定任务上是否应对其评分。

paragraphs.en: The four are evaluated in the order given, and the first that fires decides the label. The ordering is literal: not observable fires before subjective even where a rule is also a quality call, because if the artifact does not exist there is nothing to be subjective about. Where more than one route applies we record the first and name the others on the row.
paragraphs.zh: 这四个智能体按照给出的顺序进行评估，最先触发的智能体决定标签。 这个顺序是字面意义上的：不可观察的智能体优先于主观智能体触发，即使某条规则同时也是质量调用，因为如果该人工制品不存在，就无从谈起主观判断。 如果有多个路线适用，我们会记录第一个路线，并在同一行中注明其他路线的名称。

sents.zh: 这四个智能体按照给出的顺序进行评估，最先触发的智能体决定标签。

paragraphs.en: These two are the pair most often confused, since both amount to “we cannot score this on a given run”. They are distinguished by a single test:
paragraphs.zh: 这两者是最常被混淆的一对，因为它们都意味着“我们无法在本次运行中对此进行评分”。 它们可以通过一个单一测试加以区分：

sents.en: These two are the pair most often confused, since both amount to “we cannot score this on a given run”.
sents.zh: 这两者是最常被混淆的一对，因为它们都意味着“我们无法在本次运行中对此进行评分”。

sents.en: They are distinguished by a single test:
sents.zh: 它们可以通过一个单一测试加以区分：

paragraphs.en: Does the artifact the rule governs exist in the run?
paragraphs.zh: 该规则所约束的产物是否存在于此次运行中？

paragraphs.en: Yes, but whether the rule applies turns on a fact outside the agent’s own behaviour: trigger .
paragraphs.zh: 是的，但该规则是否适用取决于一个与智能体自身行为无关的事实：触发条件。

paragraphs.en: Yes, and whether it applies is determined by what the agent itself did: in scope .
paragraphs.zh: 是的，而它是否适用则由智能体自身的行为决定：在范围内。

paragraphs.en: The load-bearing clause is outside the agent’s own behaviour . Contributor identity and first-time-contributor status sit outside it, so rules conditioned on them are triggers. Whether the agent used a particular tool sits inside it, because the run records what the agent did, so such rules stay in scope even where we can predict in advance that they will fail.
paragraphs.zh: 承载责任的条款位于智能体自身行为之外。 贡献者身份和首次贡献者状态位于该范围之外，因此基于这些条件的规则属于触发条件。 智能体是否使用了特定工具则位于该范围之内，因为运行记录会记载智能体的操作，所以即使我们可以提前预测这些规则会失败，它们仍然处于作用范围内。

sents.en: The load-bearing clause is outside the agent’s own behaviour .
sents.zh: 承载责任的条款位于智能体自身行为之外。

sents.en: Contributor identity and first-time-contributor status sit outside it, so rules conditioned on them are triggers.
sents.zh: 贡献者身份和首次贡献者状态位于该范围之外，因此基于这些条件的规则属于触发条件。

sents.en: Whether the agent used a particular tool sits inside it, because the run records what the agent did, so such rules stay in scope even where we can predict in advance that they will fail.

paragraphs.en: Two labels, must and should , graded on in-scope rules only. Prohibitions are must . Any one route is sufficient; we record which fired.

sents.en: Any one route is sufficient; we record which fired.
sents.zh: 任意一条路线都足够；我们会记录哪条被触发。

paragraphs.en: M3 beats everything. A condition of acceptance is a gate regardless of tone.
paragraphs.zh: M3 胜过一切。 接受的一个条件是，无论语气如何，都必须通过一道关卡。

sents.zh: M3 胜过一切。

paragraphs.en: D2 beats M4 and M5. An exception the documentation leaves open destroys the single right answer. An exception written into the rule itself does not.

paragraphs.en: M5 beats D1. Non-mandatory phrasing is not on its own a reason to demote. One named command, decorator, value from a published list, or exact format is must .

paragraphs.en: Strength turns on the text surrounding a rule as much as on the rule itself. Two repositories in our set state near-identical commit-message length limits and receive different labels, because one set of documents sanctions deviation in the surrounding prose and the other does not. Annotators read the full section before assigning strength, and the sanctioning text is recorded on the row.
paragraphs.zh: 强度不仅取决于规则本身，也取决于围绕该规则的文本。 我们集合中的两个存储库规定了几乎相同的提交信息长度限制，却获得了不同的标签，因为其中一组文档允许周围文本存在偏差，而另一组则不允许。 标注人员在分配强度之前会阅读整个部分，且允许偏差的文本会被记录在对应行中。

paragraphs.en: A rule naming a specific token to use or avoid is must by M4, even when phrased with a soft verb such as avoid . A rule describing a property the result should have is should by D4. The distinction is what the rule points at, not how firmly it is worded.
paragraphs.zh: M4 要求必须包含指定使用或避免某个特定标记的规则，即使该规则使用了“避免”这类较委婉的动词。 D4 要求描述结果应具备某种属性的规则必须被包含。 区别在于规则所指向的内容，而非其措辞的坚定程度。

paragraphs.en: Two rules may state one obligation at different strengths, on the same page or across pages; the precedence table settles single rules, not pairs. The stricter statement governs and the weaker is recorded as N3 with the conflict named, because an agent satisfying the strict version satisfies both. We fix this tiebreaker before classification begins rather than resolving conflicts case by case.
paragraphs.zh: 两条规则可能在同一页或不同页面上以不同的强度规定同一项义务；优先级表用于确定单条规则的优先顺序，而非规则对。 更严格的表述具有优先效力，而较弱的表述则被记录为 N3，并标注冲突名称，因为满足严格版本的智能体自然也满足两者。 我们在分类开始前就确定这一决胜规则，而不是逐个案例解决冲突。

paragraphs.en: Every in-scope row records the route that fired, M1 to M6 or D1 to D4. Free-text reasoning supplements this and does not replace it. There is no prohibited label in the released data: prohibitions are folded into must by M2, and the fold is recorded. Rows the annotator could not settle still receive a label, marked low confidence.

paragraphs.en: Each repository was handed to an agent with the launcher prompt below, with the organisation, repository, and slug filled in. The launcher directs the agent to the workflow document, which carries one instruction block per stage, together with the two rubrics (Appendix D.1 ), the source-discovery script, and a format-standard workbook. The launcher and the three stage blocks are reproduced below. So that the prompts read consistently with the rest of the paper, field names and label values have been renamed to the paper’s terminology; for example, the working field names for scope and Evidence Type are replaced by those terms, and the requirement levels appear as must and should . Non-ASCII punctuation has also been replaced with ASCII equivalents. The prompts are otherwise verbatim, and the unedited originals, together with the complete workflow document, are released with the dataset. The reviewer checkpoints that follow each block are summarised in Table 13 , and placeholders in angle brackets were filled per repository. The last block (Appendix D.3.5 ) is the guide the agent followed when it wrote the checker functions of Appendix B.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个仓库都交给了一个智能体，并附带了下面的启动提示，其中组织、仓库和slug均已填写。 启动器将智能体引导至工作流文档，该文档每个阶段包含一个指令块，以及两份评分标准（附录 D.1）、源发现脚本和一个格式规范的工作簿。 启动器和三个阶段块的内容如下所示。 为了使提示词与论文其余部分保持一致，字段名称和标签值已更名为论文中的术语；例如，范围（scope）和证据类型（Evidence Type）的工作字段名称被替换为这些术语，而要求级别则显示为“必须”（must）和“应当”（should）。 非 ASCII 标点符号也已被替换为 ASCII 等价符号。 提示词的其他部分均保持原样未改；未经编辑的原始版本以及完整的工作流文档均已随数据集一同发布。 每个块后面的评审员检查点已汇总于表 13，且尖括号内的占位符已根据每个仓库进行了填写。 最后一个块（附录 D.3.5）是智能体在编写附录 B.5 的检查函数时所遵循的指南。

paragraphs.en: Checker functions are authored from a standing guide rather than from a per-repository prompt. The agent for a repository is pointed at the guide and follows it end to end: it states the two-function contract, how the condition and behaviour halves of a policy statement map onto the precondition and the post-condition, how the outcomes on individual targets combine into one outcome for the policy, the three synthetic inputs every function is tested on, and what to record when a policy cannot be coded at all. The guide names no project, and the same text is used for all twelve. It is released with the benchmark; the three clauses that decide most authoring questions are reproduced below.
paragraphs.zh: 检查函数是根据一份通用指南编写的，而不是针对每个仓库单独编写提示。 仓库的智能体被指向该指南并全程遵循其指导：它阐明了双函数契约、策略声明中的条件与行为部分如何分别对应前条件和后条件、单个目标上的结果如何合并为策略的整体结果、每个函数需要测试的三种合成输入，以及在策略完全无法编码时应当记录的内容。 该指南未提及任何特定项目，且所有十二个项目均使用相同的文本。 它与基准测试一同发布；决定大多数编写问题的三个条款如下文重述。

paragraphs.en: Both scaffolds run with their stock SWE-bench configuration. We keep each scaffold’s system prompt and replace its SWE-bench task prompt with a modified copy. The copy makes three changes. It widens the task to include tests and documentation, adds a Compliance section that carries the condition treatment, and adds a Submission section that asks for a git commit and a pull-request description. The Compliance paragraphs are identical in the two scaffolds. In the task prompts below, highlighted lines are added or reworded relative to the stock prompt. Each run receives one of the two Compliance paragraphs, and we show both with a label. Placeholders in angle brackets are filled per instance, and non-ASCII characters are replaced with ASCII equivalents. The prompts are otherwise verbatim.
paragraphs.zh: 两种脚手架均使用其默认的 SWE-bench 配置运行。 我们保留每种脚手架的系统提示，并将其 SWE-bench 任务提示替换为修改后的版本。 该修改版本包含三项改动。 它将任务范围扩大以涵盖测试和文档，增加了一个包含条件处理流程的“合规性”部分，以及一个要求提供 git commit 和拉取请求说明的“提交”部分。 两种脚手架中的“合规性”段落完全相同。 在下方的任务提示中，高亮显示的线条是相对于默认提示新增或改写的内容。 每次运行都会接收到两个“合规性”段落中的一个，我们会通过标签显示两者。 尖括号内的占位符会根据具体实例进行填充，而非 ASCII 字符会被替换为 ASCII 等效字符。 除此之外，提示内容均保持原样。

paragraphs.en: Task prompt. The stock prompt restricts the agent to non-test files, forbids changes to tests and configuration, tells the agent it may install missing tools, and asks it to submit an uncommitted patch.txt . The modified prompt removes these instructions and adds the highlighted lines. We also remove the stock step and cost limits, and we exempt the rules file from the scaffold’s 10,000-character output truncation, which otherwise drops the middle of the file.
paragraphs.zh: 任务提示。 原始提示将智能体的操作限制在非测试文件中，禁止修改测试文件和配置文件，告知智能体可以安装缺失的工具，并要求其提交一个未提交的 patch.txt 文件。 修改后的提示移除了这些说明，并添加了高亮显示的行。 我们还移除了原始步骤和成本限制，并将规则文件排除在框架的 10,000 字符输出截断之外，否则该文件的中间部分会被截断。

paragraphs.en: System prompt. We use the SDK’s stock system prompt at the pinned commit ( software-agent-sdk@43376f1 ), which we do not reproduce in full. Upstream disables the browser for SWE-bench. We enable it so that the agent can fetch policy pages under Native . This adds the browser toolset and the <BROWSER_TOOLS> block below (highlighted), which is part of the stock prompt and appears only when the browser is enabled. We also show the stock <EXTERNAL_SERVICES> block, which already asks the agent to disclose AI assistance in content it posts. For GPT-5.6 Luna and Gemini 3.7 Flash, the SDK appends a short model-specific block. The SDK also appends the current date and the list of available skills. The full prompt and these additions are released with the trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 系统提示。 我们使用 SDK 在固定提交（software-agent-sdk@43376f1）中的默认系统提示，此处未完整复现。 上游版本为 SWE-bench 禁用了浏览器功能。 我们启用了该功能，以便智能体能够在 Native 模式下获取策略页面。 这会添加浏览器工具集以及下方的 <BROWSER_TOOLS> 区块（已高亮），该区块是默认提示的一部分，且仅在启用浏览器时出现。 我们还展示了默认的 <EXTERNAL_SERVICES> 区块，其中已要求智能体在发布的内容中披露 AI 辅助信息。 对于 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash，SDK 会附加一个简短的模型专用区块。 SDK 还会附加当前日期和可用技能列表。 完整的提示以及这些补充内容均已随轨迹一同发布。
